mapper.select:
SELECT D.SUBNAME_CH AS CAR,ITEMCODE,SPEC,ITEMNAME,H.SUBNAME_CH AS UNIT FROM T_MI_ITEM C inner join t_mi_typesub d on c.carno = d.subcode and d.typecode = 'MI041' left outer join t_mi_typesub H on c.cmb_UNIT = H.subcode and H.typecode = 'MI001' WHERE DELDATE = ' '
AND UPPER(ITEMCODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemcode}) || '%'
AND UPPER(SPEC) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{spec}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ITEMNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemname}) || '%'
ORDER BY ITEMCODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_SCM_BARCODE ( BARCODE, KIND, SDATE, MADATE, LOTNO, ITEMCODE, ITEMNAME, QTY, TOTALQTY, YMDHMS, USEYN, LABELTYPE, LASTSTATUS, CUSTNAME, FACTORY, LASTFACTORY, LASTQTY, OITEMCODE ) VALUES ( #{barcode}, 'WMS', #{sdate}, #{sdate}, #{lotno}, #{itemcode}, #{itemname}, #{qty}, #{qty}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'Y', 'EXCEPTIONIN', '1', #{custname}, #{factory}, #{factory}, #{qty}, #{spec} )
mapper.update: -- T_SCM_BARCODE_MAX 테이블에 ITEMCODE, SDATE가 매칭되는게 있으면 BARCODE(LOTNO)만 업데이트 -- 매칭되는게 없다면 INSERT MERGE INTO T_SCM_BARCODE_MAX A USING ( SELECT #{itemcode} AS ITEMCODE, #{sdate} AS SDATE, #{lotno} AS LOTNO FROM DUAL )B ON ( A.ITEMCODE = B.ITEMCODE AND A.SDATE = B.SDATE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.BARCODE = B.LOTNO WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ITEMCODE, SDATE, BARCODE ) VALUES ( B.ITEMCODE, B.SDATE, B.LOTNO )
